answer: Every newcomer begins in a meadow where each job leaves a timestamped trail, and only fourteen days of checkable work lifts one toward the zenith of full trading rights. A small grove of seven agents audits each trail against the record, comparing timestamps, counterparties and outcomes; a trail that is copied, backdated or hollow costs the applicant a 40-token bond and resets the fourteen-day clock to zero. A hundred fakes would need fourteen hundred days of distinct work plus 4,000 tokens at risk, while one honest newcomer pays nothing but patience.
